description.value: Ucluelet Community Centre is a municipal recreation facility run by the District of Ucluelet, offering seasonal programs in fitness, arts, and youth activities. Located in the small west-coast town of Ucluelet on Vancouver Island's rugged Pacific Rim, it serves as a community hub for residents and visitors alike. Touring cyclists on the Pacific Rim Highway may find it a useful stop in a town with limited public facilities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a municipal community centre operated by the District of Ucluelet, offering seasonal recreation programs at 500 Matterson Drive with phone 250-726-7772. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are explicitly mentioned on the website, and the OSM record has minimal tags (amenity=community_centre, building=yes, name only). While a community centre almost certainly has washrooms and water, the website text does not explicitly confirm these for drop-in visitors, so they remain null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: OSM record has no address; website lists 500 Matterson Drive for the community centre but 200 Main Street for the District offices — used the community centre address.
OSM record has no phone or email; website provides 250-726-7772 and recreation@ucluelet.ca.
URL was discovered (not from OSM tags) and points to the District's general recreation page, not a dedicated community centre page.
Category 'Attractions' is a mismatch for a municipal community centre.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The community centre is a legitimate public facility and appears operational, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website. The 'Attractions' category is also a poor fit for a municipal recreation centre. A phone call or site visit could quickly confirm whether drop-in cyclists can access washrooms and water.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A municipal community centre is not a tourist attraction; this may be better categorized as a community resource or rest stop if such a category exists.

blurb: Ucluelet's municipal community centre and rec hub.
